summary: The six motion components' catalogue thumbnails (text-swap, icon-swap, count, presence, stagger, feedback) now draw the state BEFORE, an arrow, and the state AFTER — both at rest and at full opacity — instead of a frame caught mid-transition, which read as broken (half-faded words, clipped bars). Raised in review. Presence's live example on its detail page collapsed to an 8px column of single words: it used max-w-sm, which in this theme is --ui-space-sm, not Tailwind's container width — the trap Modal and Sheet document. It now takes an explicit w-80 max-w-full. check:utilities, which already rejects bare spacing steps on widths, scanned only registry/; it now scans apps/site/src/examples too, the code a consumer copies from a component page, and was shown failing on the Presence example before the fix.
